data.name: Survival Mission
data.detailed_description:
SurvivalMission is a survival adventure game that emphasizes real-time tactical combat.

Set in the future, with the assistance of AI, humanity has successfully cracked the mechanism of the brain and achieved brain-computer interface. To achieve a significant boost in productivity, AI is widely implanted into human bodies as an extension of the brain. Numerous carbon-based and silicon-based fused modified humans and AI are connected to the Neural Network, resulting in unprecedented productivity while creating heavy reliance on the system.

Decades later, an unknown virus breaks out, instantly paralyzing the intelligent society. Civilization collapses rapidly, leaving only a small number of humans, modified humans and AI survivors struggling to live in primitive ways. After a century of hardship, survivors around the world have established relatively stable alliances and begun to investigate the cause of the Neural Network virus outbreak.

Players take on the role of a surviving modified human. After the disaster, you choose to survive independently. You gather natural resources to craft shelters and food to sustain life, build production facilities, upgrade weapons and equipment, explore AI-controlled bases, adventure in dangerous underground prisons, rescue survivors captured by chaotic AI, and form your own survival squad.

Game Features

【RTT Combat, Extreme Operation】

The game adopts a real-time tactical combat system similar to Commandos. Enemy attacks are simple but lethal. Players must observe carefully, avoid enemy sight, use stealth properly, and take down enemies with one strike from behind. If detected, you must maneuver flexibly to avoid enemy reinforcements.

Players can freely design the types and positions of defensive guards, creating countless possibilities. The entire combat process is highly immersive, balancing strategic thinking and operational skills.

【Rescue Teammates, Compete for Resources】

Combat is no longer a solo battle — it requires team coordination and tactical cooperation. Different combinations lead to different strategies. Each teammate has distinct personalities and abilities: sniping, mine-laying, hacking, disguise, and more, simple yet practical.

Teammates are not controlled by AI; every member can be operated independently and switched freely. You have full control over the entire battle. Rescuing teammates requires free exploration, where danger and opportunity coexist.

【Capture Outposts, Build Strong Defense】

Outposts are the only source of rare resources, so protecting them is critical. All facilities can be freely fortified: walls, mines, surveillance mechanical soldiers, patrolling drones, one-hit-kill turrets. You can focus on protecting resources or buildings.

Every player has a unique defensive strategy, forming different defense systems. It is a pure intellectual confrontation.

【Build Homeland, Survive Adversity】

A well-defended outpost keeps your homeland safe from raids. Players can fully enjoy building, constructing various equipment and tools to improve the world. New devices, tools, recipes and items are constantly added.

With patience and diligence, you can design your unique homeland, build a complete industrial ecosystem, and create a prosperous and beautiful new settlement.

【Human-AI Fusion, Battle Against AI】

The game world is a continuous world composed of nearly 30 regions, with different exploration routes for each player. Special random events occur occasionally and affect the whole world.

Hostile AI-modified humans and cyborgs spread across all regions, with more than a dozen AI control stations hidden inside. Players must advance cautiously.

data.short_description: SurvivalMission: A survival adventure that fuses real-time tactical stealth, base building, and squad recruitment. Battle rogue AI in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, gather your team, and rebuild civilization from the ashes.
